## Package

Roadmap ID and issue link.

## What changed

Two to five lines.

## Evals run

Which evals, and what each produced. Write "none, because" if no agent, skill, or knowledge entry changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] One package, one branch
- [ ] Knowledge entries: own words, tier and version cited, verified date, in `INDEX.md`
- [ ] Sources used are in `knowledge/SOURCES.md`
- [ ] Skills under about 120 lines; depth in `knowledge/`
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/decisions.md` if the project's shape changed
- [ ] Nothing pasted from a vendor, practitioner, or private source
